subject: Execution readiness decision & paperflow for MAP/eval — go/no-go and start date
messages:
From: Claire Wong <claire@atlasai.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 16:24:00 -0700
Subject: Atlas MAP + procurement timeline (SOW attached)

Hi Aditya / Laura,

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. Attached is our consolidated MAP (MAP_Atlas_v2.xlsx) and the latest SOW (Atlas_SOW_v3.pdf). High-level ask: Atlas needs a clear go/no-go checkpoint and a contract routing window so our procurement/legal teams can approve before the fiscal close. Proposed constraints from our side: PO issued by 2027-04-27 and project start no earlier than 2027-05-03.

Key items in the MAP:
- Evaluation window: 2 weeks (sandbox access already arranged)
- Success criteria: latency < 250ms p95 for 1k qps sim; token cost target defined in sheet
- Security evidence: SOC2 snapshot + data retention notes (see tab 3)

Please confirm your internal approval chain and the expected DocuSign routing order so we can coordinate with procurement. If you can get a clear go/no-go checkpoint date this week that would help.

Attachments: Atlas_SOW_v3.pdf (pdf), MAP_Atlas_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Claire Wong
Senior Procurement Lead, Atlas AI
claire@atlasai.com

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Claire Wong <claire@atlasai.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Atlas MAP + procurement timeline (SOW attached)

Claire — thanks for the docs and the clear timeline. Quick read; looks good.

Internal note / ask for Redwood approvers: Laura, Monica, Vivek — looping you in to confirm routing and SLAs for review. Proposed Redwood plan below (please confirm):
- Go/no-go checkpoint: 2027-04-23 (final MAP evaluation report & brief exec signoff)
- Contract routing: DocuSign start 2027-04-24, signer order Legal -> Finance -> Sales -> Customer
- Target PO by 2027-04-27; Start date: 2027-05-03 if PO signed

If legal needs more time we can short-circuit by pre-authorizing a temporary limited sandbox access after finance okays credit terms, but final production traffic would require signed SOW + PO.

Claire — is a 2027-04-23 go/no-go checkpoint workable on your side (we'll deliver the MAP evaluation summary by EOD 04/22)? Also confirm who in procurement will sign the DocuSign envelope.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, Claire Wong <claire@atlasai.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Atlas MAP + procurement timeline (SOW attached)

Thanks, Aditya and Claire — outline looks reasonable. A few clarifications from a legal/ops perspective:

1) Approvals required (Redwood):
   - Legal review (Vivek) — contract and liability redlines — estimated 2 business days if clean
   - Finance (Monica) — payment terms + credit; needs PO copy to close
   - Sales Ops (Laura) — project cadence, onboarding SLA scheduling

2) DocuSign routing: proposed order: Vivek (Legal) -> Monica (Finance) -> Aditya (Sales) -> Atlas signatory. If Atlas prefers different order we can adapt but order above avoids rework after finance edits.

3) Contingency: if PO timing slips past 04/27, we can provision a capped test environment for one week while procurement finalizes. Production start will still require a signed SOW + PO.

Action items:
- Vivek: confirm legal availability to start review 04/24 and flag any major redlines by 04/26
- Monica: confirm finance terms and PO process (payment net terms and whether credit memo required)

Claire — can you confirm the Atlas signatory name/email for the DocuSign envelope and whether procurement requires countersignature order change?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Claire Wong <claire@atlasai.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Atlas MAP + procurement timeline (SOW attached)

Looping in finance details. Quick answers:
- We can accept a standard PO (no prepayment). Net 30 preferred; if Atlas needs Net 45 we can escalate but that may trigger a credit review.
- For this size we do not require a credit memo if procurement can provide a PO by 04/27 and a billing contact.
- I will sign in the DocuSign order after legal clears. If legal requests material changes that affect billing terms, we will hold final finance sign-off until those are resolved.

Monica Patel
Finance Manager, Customer Billing — Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

Subject: FINAL: Go decision & DocuSign handoff (Atlas MAP)

Claire — all internal checks complete; this is our formal "GO" contingent on Atlas issuing the PO by 2027-04-27 and signing the DocuSign envelope. Summary below and next steps:

Summary of approvals (confirmed):
- Legal (Vivek) — ready to start review 04/24, will turn around in 48 hours for clean SOW
- Finance (Monica) — accepts standard PO; prepared to sign once PO received
- Sales Ops (Laura) — onboarding window reserved; start date target 2027-05-03

DocuSign envelope and flow:
- Link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC123 (also in attachments)
- Signer order: Vivek Kulkarni (Legal) -> Monica Patel (Finance) -> Aditya Rao (Sales) -> Atlas signatory (TBD)
- Please confirm Atlas signatory name/email so I can set the envelope to go live 2027-04-24.

Contingency and limited access: we will provision a capped sandbox environment the week of 04/26 if Atlas needs additional time to route PO; production traffic will not be enabled until signed SOW + PO received.

Attachments: DocuSign_Authorization_Redwood-Atlas.url (link), Atlas_SOW_v3.pdf, MAP_Atlas_v2.xlsx

Thanks — I will watch for your signatory info and PO.

Regards,
